title: Map of Smith Sound, showing Dr Hayes's track and discoveries
creator: drawn by Isaac Israel Hayes, engraved by J. Schedler
description: The chart of Smith Sound with the schooner United States's track and the ground Hayes claimed to have covered in 1860-61, engraved for his narrative.

title: Map of Port Foulke, the winter quarters of the expedition
creator: drawn by Isaac Israel Hayes, engraved by J. Schedler
description: Plan of Port Foulke on the Greenland shore of Smith Sound, where the United States lay through the winter of 1860-61, with soundings and the shore establishments marked.

title: An Arctic team
creator: G. G. White, from a sketch by Hayes; engraved by J. A. Bogert
description: A full dog team in harness at speed, drawn from Hayes's own sketch.

title: A bear-hunt
creator: Darley, from description; engraved by J. A. Bogert
description: Dogs holding a polar bear at bay while the hunters close - drawn by Darley from a verbal description rather than from life, as the plate itself admits.

title: Crossing the hummocks
creator: G. G. White, from a sketch by Hayes; engraved by J. A. Bogert
description: A sledge party manhandling loads over broken hummocky ice, the worst going of a spring journey.

title: The shores of the polar sea
creator: H. Fenn, from a sketch by Hayes; engraved by Fay and Cox
description: The coast at Hayes's farthest north, where he believed he had reached the open polar sea - a claim later shown to be mistaken about both the position and the water.

title: A walrus-hunt
creator: Darley, from description; engraved by J. A. Bogert
description: Inughuit hunters at a walrus from kayaks and the floe edge.

title: Tailpiece: anchor
creator: G. G. White, engraved by J. A. Bogert
description: The anchor tailpiece closing the introduction.

title: Tailpiece: arched iceberg
creator: G. G. White, from a photograph or sketch by Hayes
description: A berg pierced by an arch, drawn from Hayes's own material.

title: Tailpiece: a Greenlander in his kayak
creator: G. G. White, from a photograph or sketch by Hayes
description: A Greenlander in his kayak with harpoon and bladder, drawn at Proven.

title: Tailpiece: Upernavik
creator: G. G. White, from a photograph by Hayes
description: The Danish settlement of Upernavik, the last colony before the ice.

title: Tailpiece: snowflake, magnified three diameters
creator: G. G. White, from a sketch by Hayes
description: A snow crystal drawn magnified three diameters. Hayes used the same figure three more times in the book; it is a small piece of nineteenth-century field microscopy printed as an ornament.

title: Tailpiece: seal on a cake of ice
creator: G. G. White, from a sketch by Hayes
description: A seal hauled out on a pan of ice.

title: Tailpiece: head of a reindeer
creator: G. G. White, from a sketch by Hayes
description: A caribou head drawn as a natural history figure.

title: Tailpiece: Port Foulke
creator: G. G. White, from a photograph by Hayes
description: A view of the winter harbour at Port Foulke.

title: Tailpiece: Chester Valley, showing Alida Lake and the glacier
creator: G. G. White, from a sketch by Hayes
description: The valley behind Port Foulke with its lake and the ice front beyond.

title: Tailpiece: My Brother John's Glacier, from the first camp
creator: G. G. White, from a sketch by Hayes
description: The glacier Kane named for his brother, seen from Hayes's first camp on the inland ice journey.

title: Tailpiece: group of reindeer
creator: G. G. White, from a sketch by Hayes
description: Caribou on the tundra behind the winter quarters, the fresh meat that kept the party from scurvy.

title: Tailpiece: the schooner in winter quarters
creator: G. G. White, from a photograph by Hayes
description: The schooner United States housed over for the winter at Port Foulke, 1860-61.

title: Tailpiece: the Esquimau hut at Etah
creator: G. G. White, from a photograph by Hayes
description: A stone and turf winter house at Etah, the northernmost settlement in the world at the time.

title: Tailpiece: head of a walrus
creator: G. G. White, from a sketch by Hayes
description: A walrus head drawn as a specimen figure.

title: Tailpiece: portrait of Birdie, the Arctic fox
creator: G. G. White, from a sketch by Hayes
description: A portrait of Birdie, an Arctic fox kept aboard the schooner - a named animal of the expedition, drawn from life.

title: Tailpiece: Sonntag's grave
creator: G. G. White, from a sketch by Hayes
description: The grave of August Sonntag, the expedition's astronomer, who died in December 1860 on a sledge journey to buy dogs from the Inughuit.

title: Tailpiece: camping in a snow-bank
creator: G. G. White, from a sketch by Hayes
description: A party digging into a drift for shelter on the march.

title: Tailpiece: polar bear
creator: G. G. White, from a sketch by Hayes
description: A polar bear on the floe.

title: Tailpiece: dog sledge
creator: G. G. White, from a sketch by Hayes
description: The sledge and its harnessed team, drawn as equipment.

title: Tailpiece: head of the Esquimau dog Oosisoak
creator: G. G. White, from a sketch by Hayes
description: A portrait of Oosisoak, one of the expedition's Greenland dogs, named and drawn individually.

title: Tailpiece: Cape Union
creator: G. G. White, from a sketch by Hayes
description: Cape Union on the Ellesmere shore at the head of the Kennedy Channel.

title: Tailpiece: a sketch
creator: G. G. White, from a sketch by Hayes
description: One of the two untitled sketch tailpieces in the book.

title: Tailpiece: the observatory at Port Foulke
creator: G. G. White, from a photograph by Hayes
description: The magnetic and astronomical observatory built ashore at Port Foulke - the fixed point from which the expedition's science was done.

title: Tailpiece: Kalutunah and his family
creator: G. G. White, from a photograph by Hayes
description: Kalutunah, the Inughuit leader who had helped Kane's people and who hunted and travelled with Hayes, with his family.

title: Tailpiece: head of an Arctic hare
creator: G. G. White, from a sketch by Hayes
description: An Arctic hare drawn as a natural history figure.

title: Tailpiece: a sketch (Whale Sound)
creator: G. G. White, from a sketch by Hayes
description: The second untitled sketch tailpiece, on the page that also carries the Tyndall Glacier plate reference.

title: Tailpiece: "End"
creator: G. G. White, engraved by J. A. Bogert
description: The closing device of the volume.
